# DSH Team Fishbone · 团队鱼骨图
A session-header panel for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): visualize sub-agents as an interactive fishbone d
iagram, inspect assignments and live state, then open the child session for its full execution trace
agram, inspect assignments and live state, then open the child session for its full execution trace.
DSH 会话标题栏的团队看板：用鱼骨图展示主 Agent 与子 Agent 的分配关系、任务描述、运行状态和可用的用时/Token 指标，点击节点查看详情并进入子会话。
## Features / 功能
- Direct sub-agent fishbone nodes plus nested child navigation when their catalog projections are lo

aded.
- 运行中使用主题品牌色与动态连接线；已完成使用成功色；已结束使用警告色；空闲和失败分别使用中性及错误色。
- Assignments come from sub-agent catalo
g labels and teammate descriptions; shared task-board entries are optional, not required for nodes t

o appear.
- 子节点详情含快捷切换、任务说明、可用的轮次/步骤/Token/用时指标；过程摘要仅在宿主下发对应投影时展示。
- One click opens the native sub-

agent session; the plugin does not create agents or change shared tasks.
- 中英双语，跟随宿主主题，无第三方运行时依赖，无安装

nt session; the plugin does not create agents or change shared tasks.
- 中英双语，跟随宿主主题，无第三方运行时依赖，无安装脚本。
## Install / 安装
In DSH, ask your agent / 在 DSH 中对 AI 说：
> 安装插件 https://github.com/outmanwt/dsh-team-fishbone/releases/latest/download/dsh-team-fishbone.tgz
Or use the plugin-manager tool with these arguments / 也可调用插件管理工具，参数：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For CLI-managed profiles / 对于自行管理的 CLI profile：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Desktop users should install through their running app's plugin manager, not an unrelated `web` prof
ile. Follow the installation result for refresh/restart instructions.
桌面版请通过正在使用的应用安装到当前 profile；不要另建 `web` profile。安装后按宿主提示刷新或重启，再点击会话标题旁的「团队鱼骨」。
### Local development / 本地开发
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Install the absolute directory through `plugin_manager` with `action: install_bundle`. There is no b
uild step: the checked-in client file is the browser artifact.
## Compatibility / 兼容说明
Developed and manually tried on DSH 0.2.1-rc.3. Uses the native conversation header slot, sub-agent
catalog, session-status hooks, and optional experimental Agent Teams projections. Older versions are
not verified; experimental projection contracts may change. Missing summary data is displayed as un
available rather than invented.
已在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 环境中开发并人工试用。依赖原生会话标题栏 slot、子代理目录及状态 hooks；Agent Teams 共享任务板是可选数据源。其他版本尚未完成兼容测试。
## Privacy / 数据
The plugin reads projections already available to the local DSH client and requests native child-ses
sion projection refreshes. It adds no external network endpoint, analytics, or credential storage. I
t does not bundle session transcripts, personal paths, or tokens.
## Releases / 持续发布
See RELEASING.md. Tags matching the package version trigger GitHub Actions to check the bundle and a
ttach a fixed-name `dsh-team-fishbone.tgz` plus SHA-256 checksums to a GitHub Release. The package i
s distributed through GitHub; it is **not published to npm**.
The `@local/dsh-team-fishbone` name is retained to preserve existing installations. It is a package
identifier, not a claim of npm availability.
## Community market / 市场收录
The market application reads the Awesome DSH Plugin catalog. Listing requires a separate catalog PR
and maintainer acceptance; a public repository alone does not make the plugin searchable there. See
marketplace/outmanwt__dsh-team-fishbone.yml for the proposed entry.
## Credits / 致谢
Uses the DSH/Cordis extension APIs. Some projection-reading and native-session-navigation patterns w
ere adapted from the MIT-licensed DeepSeek Harness built-in Agent Teams and sub-agent UI packages. S
d from the MIT-licensed DeepSeek Harness built-in Agent Teams and sub-agent UI packages. See NOTICE.
